name: Emdoor Information CO.,LTD.
summary: Emdoor Information CO.,LTD. provides electronic products and solutions in China and internationally. The company offers rugged tablet, rugged AI PC, industrial PC, rugged notebook, outdoor rugged, vehicle PC, and rugged handhelds, as well as AI servers and AI workstations, AI software solutions, XR/AI wearable products, and consumer computers and tablets; and Customized cash register, POS machine, sports equipment, and home control platform. It also provides software and hardware services. In addition, the company offers public utilities, intelligent manufacturing, warehouse management, and transportation solutions for energy industry, medical industry, surveying and mapping industries.
